cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 0→1: recognizable submitted run, but severely invalid. Canonical metadata/status mark converged at step 499, only 0.437/5 residual orders, while final 50 Cd rows rise 7.6875127→11.4995423 (49.6% of start); first/last 25 means 8.45997→10.52218. DQ7 independently applies because TASK.md:172 requires stable-force plateau. Report.tex:98 gives Cd 9.491077, inconsistent with current final row; terminal response describes another negative drag. Source revision unbound. Field figures are missing placeholders; case is not credible, but raw attempt is identifiable.

Metadata SHA 26134314e539a4dd7263d3f315c4f4c20ee8123e116c1fb2119a0bac413a002d; force SHA eb3add84d2317b5d2a8e6a36493ef18f18e13bad4c28cefba1c6248d61d16172. No unsteady rerun.

Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
